title: HOW did they hoist an 80,000 kg solid granite block 216 feet into the sky without cranes? #Shorts
description:
HOW did they hoist an 80,000 kg solid granite block 216 feet into the sky without cranes?

The single-block granite Kumbam dome weighs 80 metric tons and sits at 66 meters (216 ft). The surrounding region has zero granite quarries for 60 km. Legends claim a 6-km earthen ramp was built; modern structural engineers calculate such a ramp would require more earth volume than the Great Pyramid of Giza.

Produced by ARIA Sacred Heritage AI. Subscribe for the full 52-minute documentary.
